proof.text: Derive QuasiSeparatedSpace X from f over the affine base. The affine open V is compact by hVaff.isCompact. Apply QuasiSeparatedSpace.inter_isCompact to U and V, obtaining compactness of U intersection V.

Apply the union comparison triangle construction to K,K′,φ and the three compactness proofs. It supplies two distinguished triangles and their morphism with components exactly b_(U union V), biprod.map b_U b_V and b_(U intersection V). No local invertibility is passed to this construction.

Register the two local IsIso hypotheses and identify biprod.map b_U b_V with the hom of biprod.mapIso (asIso b_U) (asIso b_V). Infer its invertibility. Transport along the component equalities to get IsIso of the second and third components. Apply Mathlib Pretriangulated.isIso₁_of_isIso₂₃ and rewrite the first-component equality to get the required comparison on the union.

title: Affine-adjoining gluing for the single-complex open comparison
statement: Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S, g′:X′→X be a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with both bases affine and f quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let K and K′ have quasi-coherent derived cohomology [def-pc-derived-category], and let φ:L(g′)*K→K′ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. For a quasi-compact open U and an affine open V in X, if the canonical open comparisons b_U, b_V and b_(U∩V) [def-pc-single-complex-open-comparison] are isomorphisms, then b_(U∪V) is an isomorphism. No stalk condition and no cover of the entire X are assumed.

from.place: The qcqs single-complex comparison used in the relatively flat degree-zero base-change argument: Mayer--Vietoris induction step adjoining one affine open.

lean.statement:
theorem singleComplexOpenComparison_affine_union
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K)
    (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X') (hK' : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X' K')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (U V : X.Opens)
    (hUqc : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hVaff : IsAffineOpen V)
    (hU : IsIso (singleComplexOpenComparison f f' g g' sq.w K K' φ U))
    (hV : IsIso (singleComplexOpenComparison f f' g g' sq.w K K' φ V))
    (hUV : IsIso (singleComplexOpenComparison f f' g g' sq.w K K' φ (U ⊓ V))) :
    IsIso (singleComplexOpenComparison f f' g g' sq.w K K' φ (U ⊔ V))
